future_llm_extraction_candidates.description: Extracting athletes, venues, dates, and medals from the [Infobox Olympic event] block at the start of the text.
future_llm_extraction_candidates.reasoning: While semi-structured, extracting fields from the raw text block requires either complex/brittle regex heuristics or LLM extraction to reliably normalize entity names (e.g. 'Rudolf DombiRoland Kökény').

future_llm_extraction_candidates.description: Extracting hyperlinks or cross-references to other documents.
future_llm_extraction_candidates.reasoning: Wikipedia text usually contains links, but they are not preserved in the raw text provided. LLM extraction would be needed to find mentions of other entities.

rejected_relationships.name: Document_to_Athlete
rejected_relationships.reason: Athletes are only mentioned in the raw text (e.g. inside the infobox or body). Cannot be reliably derived without NLP.
